request.description: Replace the raccoon with a warm golden baby jewel hamster. Preserve the exact sitting front three-quarter angle, full-body framing, and both visible eyes. Keep both raised forepaws apart from the two grounded hind feet. Give it cream cheeks, small round ears, a tiny tail, and a compact blue crystal cluster attached beside its shoulder. Remove the raccoon mask, scarf and pouch. Keep the same detailed pixel-art shading.

Turn it into a gray dwarf hamster with a cream belly and an amethyst cluster visibly held in its raised forepaws. Preserve the reference sitting three-quarter camera, both visible eyes, and clearly separated grounded hind feet. Small rounded ears, tiny tail, no scarf, no raccoon mask. Preserve detail and framing.

Turn the sparrow into a golden very young chick. Keep the reference three-quarter camera, folded wing clearly above two separate feet, and short beak. Replace brown plumage with yellow down and add a red-orange flame-shaped crest attached to the head. Remove blue collar and bobber. Keep pixel-art detail and framing.

Change the sparrow into a charcoal baby chick with a cream throat and a short attached flame tail. Preserve the exact three-quarter camera, wings above the feet, and both separate feet. Remove the collar and charm. Small amber bill and low amber crest. Preserve the clean pixel detailing.

Replace the hedgehog with a short caramel wild boar piglet with cream baby stripes, a blunt pink snout and small rounded ears. Match its exact low three-quarter angle with both eyes and clearly separated feet. Tiny tail, no tusks, leaf or spines. Maintain detailed pixel-art rendering and framing.

Replace the hedgehog with a compact ash-brown baby boar with subtle buff stripes, small upright rounded ears and a short dusty-pink snout. Match the reference low three-quarter angle showing both eyes and visible separated feet. No tusks, leaf or spines. Preserve pixel-art detail, framing and transparent background.
